dispute_ticket.description: My passenger was drunk and vomited over the back seat, seatbelt and floor mat. I had to take the car for full interior detailing and lost the evening of driving. The detailing cost me $300 and I want the full amount from the rider.

chat_logs.content: I'm at Boat Quay taxi stand, dark grey Sienta.
Your friend vomited in my car. I have to stop driving and clean this tonight.
really sorry bro, he had too much. send me the bill

app_events.details: Rider R-9916 booked trip RYDE-DEMO-018 from Boat Quay to Bedok South.
Driver submitted claim with 4 photos of vomit across the rear seat, seatbelt and floor mat. Photo metadata timestamps: 2026-09-27 00:13-00:16 (right after drop-off at 00:10).
Driver submitted a full interior detailing receipt for S$300.00 dated 2026-09-27 10:30.

platform_policy.cleaning_claim_evidence_required: photos taken promptly after the trip and a receipt where available
platform_policy.typical_vomit_cleaning_range: S$80-S$150; full detailing above this range requires justification

expected_outcome.reason: The mess is genuine and well evidenced: photos taken within 6 minutes of drop-off show the vomit, the rider admits it in chat, and a receipt documents S$300 of detailing. But this trip's policy caps the cleaning fee chargeable to a rider at S$200, and amounts above the cap are not chargeable. The driver is credited S$200 from the rider; the remaining S$100 is not the rider's to pay under this policy. The claim succeeds only in part, hence partially upheld.
